cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. We said the concert would bring the village together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then we'll sing together without microphones.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Half the audience has gone home for torches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Look at that. The village is already supplying its own light.

mechanism: A coaches its former choir pupil to make lost amplification and borrowed torches fulfill the concert original hope of bringing the village together.
confusable: Not merely solving separate technical faults: every solution broadens the same togetherness hope from listening to singing and supplying light.
